description: One-call project digest: article counts by lifecycle status, the REVIEW queue with word counts, posts published in the last 7 days, content plans due in the next 7 days, the latest published post, quota usage, the project's current autonomy level (L1 = nothing ships without agent review; L2 = clean articles auto-publish), the agent-memory index with note counts and recently updated titles, and — when Search Console is connected — which published posts Google has not indexed yet.
